nodes.statement: Definition A1 of the source note. Fix a finite set M of measurements with finite outcome sets and a cover C of M by maximal contexts, and write E(U) for the set of outcome assignments on U. An observer tuple is O = (K, Adm, norm, Term, L). K = (M, C, E). Adm is the convex hull conv(A) of the vectors (delta_g restricted to C) over all contexts C, for g in E(M). The norm is the l1 norm on the stacked context distributions. Term maps the defect and the claim to a status: defect 0 gives ExactRepair, defect above 0 with a support-level global section gives ClosedResidual, and otherwise OpenObstruction. L is the diagnostic layer. The defect of a claim e = (e_C), one distribution per context, is Delta_O(e) = min over p in Adm of the l1 norm of (e - p). The five components are a projection of the four packets of WDP chapter 10 (presentation, memory, evaluator, policy) and of the chapter 15 grade. The monograph defines no five-tuple of its own; the ledger row records a search for "5-tuple" that returned nothing.
nodes.bottleneck: A reading of WDP-CH10-D01 to D04, not a derivation. WDP chapter 15 has no node in this graph, so the layer component has no repository node to attach to. No source relates the L1 observer axioms H1 to H5 to this five-component tuple.

nodes.statement: In Lean (LggrFiniteResults), a finitely supported measure with natural-number weights is a list of (value, weight) pairs, and pushforward along f maps each value by f and keeps its weight. Then: push of the identity is the identity (push_id); push along g after f equals push along the composite (push_comp); total mass is unchanged (mass_push); and the weight at b of push f p equals the mass of the entries of p whose image is b (weightAt_push). The note reads marginalisation of a context distribution as such a pushforward along the restriction map, so these are the identity and composition laws of the functor from the opposite of the context poset to probability vectors (Lemma B2). That reading is not a Lean statement. Not covered: rational weights, normalisation to probability vectors, the context poset, and the Rust types. The ledger row states the same narrowing.

nodes.statement: In Lean (LggrFiniteResults), take a length n > 0 and edge parities b : Nat -> Bool. Let holonomy b k be the exclusive or of b 0, ..., b (k-1), and call g a section when, for every i < n, the exclusive or of g i and g ((i+1) mod n) equals b i. Then (section_exists_iff_holonomy_zero) a section exists if and only if holonomy b n = false. Further (no_joint_measure_when_holonomy_one), if holonomy b n = true then no finitely supported natural-weight measure on assignments Nat -> Bool with positive total mass has, for every i < n, zero pushforward weight on every pair of values (g i, g ((i+1) mod n)) whose exclusive or differs from b i. These are the clause "G(e) is nonempty iff the holonomy h is 0" and the clause "holonomy 1 forbids a positive-mass joint measure with parity-supported marginals" of Proposition B6. Not in Lean: the arc-cover clause, the noncontextual-fraction clause and the Cech-cohomology reading.
nodes.bottleneck: The Lean statement is the narrowed one above; no Lean statement mentions a nerve, a cohomology class or the noncontextual fraction. Lean not rebuilt in this change.

nodes.statement: Proposition B3(1). For an empirical model e = (e_C) on a finite scenario, let A be the matrix whose column g, for g in E(M), is the stacked vector of the point masses of g restricted to each context, and let NCF(e) = max of the sum of lambda_g over lambda >= 0 with A lambda <= e. Then these are equivalent: e has a global section (a probability vector d on E(M) with marginal e_C on every context C); e lies in conv(A); NCF(e) = 1. This is the local-hidden-variable condition. Instances recomputed exactly: the mixture (1/2)(delta_g1 + delta_g2), with g1 = (0,0,0,0) and g2 = (1,0,0,1) on (a, a', b, b'), has NCF 1; the noisy PR box (1 - lam) PR + lam U at lam = 1/2 has NCF 1 and a distribution as a global section.
nodes.bottleneck: Not formalised in Lean (ledger row L035-L1, node OPS-LEAN-GAP). The proof is in the note and is not machine-checked.

nodes.statement: Proposition B3(3). Write G(e) for the set of g in E(M) with e_C(g restricted to C) > 0 for every context C. Then e is strongly contextual (G(e) is empty) if and only if NCF(e) = 0: if lambda_g > 0 is feasible then e_C(g|C) >= lambda_g > 0 for every C, so g is in G(e); conversely g in G(e) makes lambda = (min over C of e_C(g|C)) delta_g feasible with positive weight. Instance recomputed exactly: the PR box on the Bell scenario (contexts ab, ab', a'b, a'b', each uniform on the two outcome pairs with parity 0, 0, 0, 1) has |G| = 0 and NCF 0. The four parity constraints x_a + x_b = 0, x_a + x_b' = 0, x_a' + x_b = 0 and x_a' + x_b' = 1 sum to 0 = 1 modulo 2, so none of the 16 assignments satisfies all.

nodes.statement: Proposition B4(1). Let S(U) be the set of assignments s on U whose restriction to every maximal context C inside U lies in the support of e_C; then S(M) = G(e). Over the cover of M by its maximal contexts, every matching family (s_C in S(C), agreeing on overlaps) glues to exactly one element of S(M). So a descent classifier on that cover reports no NoGlobalExtension, its fibers are in bijection with G(e), and strong contextuality appears as zero matching families, not as a failed gluing. Instances recomputed exactly: the PR box has 0 matching families; the noisy PR box at lam = 1/2 has 16, each with exactly one gluing.

nodes.statement: Existence witness. On the Bell scenario let e = (1/2)(delta_g1 + delta_g2) with g1 = (a, a', b, b') = (0,0,0,0) and g2 = (1,0,0,1). Then NCF(e) = 1 and G(e) has 2 elements. Over the arc cover {a, a', b}, {a', b, b'}, which omits the context {a, b'}, there are 4 matching families; 2 of them have exactly one gluing in S(M) and 2 have none. So a noncontextual model can have matching families without a global extension on a cover that omits a context.

nodes.statement: Proposition B5. Let N be the nerve of the maximal-context cover and take cochains valued in the presheaf U -> Q^E(U), with (delta0 alpha)_(C,C') the restriction of alpha_C to the overlap minus the restriction of alpha_C', and delta1 the alternating sum of restrictions on triples. Then delta1 delta0 = 0; for an empirical model e read as a 0-cochain, delta0 e = 0 if and only if e is no-signalling; and Phi_1([omega]) = min over alpha of the l1 norm of (omega - delta0 alpha) is unchanged by omega -> omega - delta0 beta. Instances recomputed exactly: the Bell nerve has four edges (a 4-cycle) and no triple, so delta1 delta0 = 0 is vacuous there; on the cover {0,1}, {0,2}, {0,3} (one nerve triple, overlap {0}) delta1 delta0 alpha = 0 for a non-constant alpha while a 1-cochain supported on one pair has delta1 beta = [1, 0]; delta0 e = 0 for the PR box and is nonzero at the pair (0,1) for a model whose a-marginal differs between the contexts ab and ab'; the unit cochain (1, 1) on the first edge of the Bell nerve has Phi_1 = 2, by the value 2 at alpha = 0 and a dual witness of sup norm 1 that annihilates delta0, and Phi_1 is again 2 after adding delta0 of a coboundary.

nodes.statement: Assumed from Vorob'ev (Theory of Probability and its Applications 7 (1962) 147-163, doi:10.1137/1107014), as the note states it: if the hypergraph (M, C) is GYO-acyclic (it reduces to nothing by removing ears and absorbed vertices, equivalently it has a join tree), then every no-signalling model has a global section given on a join tree T by d(g) = (product over C of e_C(g|C)) / (product over the edges (C, C') of T of e_(C intersect C')(g|C intersect C')), with 0/0 = 0. The note gives an induction sketch, not a full proof. The converse (for every non-acyclic hypergraph some no-signalling family has no global section) is not implemented; the PR box on the 4-cycle is one instance.
imported_structure: Vorob'ev: a GYO-acyclic cover glues every no-signalling model by the join-tree product formula (assumption; cited)

nodes.statement: Lemma A2. Let O' leave one of K, Adm, norm, Term undeclared, and require that an evaluation's receipt for a claim agree across every admissible completion of the undeclared component. Then no evaluation of O' meets that requirement: for each of the four components there are two admissible completions, agreeing elsewhere, whose receipts for one claim differ. Witnesses on the PR box (Bell scenario, parity targets 0, 0, 0, 1): K, the Bell cover gives defect 2 and the acyclic sub-cover {ab, ab'} gives defect 0; Adm, the noncontextual polytope gives 2 and the no-signalling polytope gives 0, because the PR box is no-signalling; norm, the l1 norm gives 2 and twice the l1 norm gives 4; Term, with defect 2 and empty global support the rule of the note gives OpenObstruction and the rule "defect below 3 gives ExactRepair" gives ExactRepair. The lemma does not say that no function from claims to receipts exists; any one completion defines a function. The layer has no row, because Definition A1 fixes it to diagnostic.

records.name: Observer tuple for empirical claims
records.obligation: A reading of WDP-CH10-D01 to D04, not a derivation. WDP chapter 15 has no node in this graph, so the layer component has no repository node to attach to. No source relates the L1 observer axioms H1 to H5 to this five-component tuple.
records.summary: Definition A1 of the source note. Fix a finite set M of measurements with finite outcome sets and a cover C of M by maximal contexts, and write E(U) for the set of outcome assignments on U. An observer tuple is O = (K, Adm, norm, Term, L). K = (M, C, E). Adm is the convex hull conv(A) of the vectors (delta_g restricted to C) over all contexts C, for g in E(M). The norm is the l1 norm on the stacked context distributions. Term maps the defect and the claim to a status: defect 0 gives ExactRepair, defect above 0 with a support-level global section gives ClosedResidual, and otherwise OpenObstruction. L is the diagnostic layer. The defect of a claim e = (e_C), one distribution per context, is Delta_O(e) = min over p in Adm of the l1 norm of (e - p). The five components are a projection of the four packets of WDP chapter 10 (presentation, memory, evaluator, policy) and of the chapter 15 grade. The monograph defines no five-tuple of its own; the ledger row records a search for "5-tuple" that returned nothing.

records.name: Pushforward of natural-number measures is functorial (Lean)
records.obligation: The Lean statement is the narrowed one above. The functor over rational probability vectors is proved in prose in the note (Lemma B2) and its instances on the PR box and the noisy PR boxes are recomputed by the independent check, which does not test the Lean statement. Lean not rebuilt in this change.
records.summary: In Lean (LggrFiniteResults), a finitely supported measure with natural-number weights is a list of (value, weight) pairs, and pushforward along f maps each value by f and keeps its weight. Then: push of the identity is the identity (push_id); push along g after f equals push along the composite (push_comp); total mass is unchanged (mass_push); and the weight at b of push f p equals the mass of the entries of p whose image is b (weightAt_push). The note reads marginalisation of a context distribution as such a pushforward along the restriction map, so these are the identity and composition laws of the functor from the opposite of the context poset to probability vectors (Lemma B2). That reading is not a Lean statement. Not covered: rational weights, normalisation to probability vectors, the context poset, and the Rust types. The ledger row states the same narrowing.

records.name: Parity cycles: holonomy and global sections (Lean)
records.obligation: The Lean statement is the narrowed one above; no Lean statement mentions a nerve, a cohomology class or the noncontextual fraction. Lean not rebuilt in this change.
records.summary: In Lean (LggrFiniteResults), take a length n > 0 and edge parities b : Nat -> Bool. Let holonomy b k be the exclusive or of b 0, ..., b (k-1), and call g a section when, for every i < n, the exclusive or of g i and g ((i+1) mod n) equals b i. Then (section_exists_iff_holonomy_zero) a section exists if and only if holonomy b n = false. Further (no_joint_measure_when_holonomy_one), if holonomy b n = true then no finitely supported natural-weight measure on assignments Nat -> Bool with positive total mass has, for every i < n, zero pushforward weight on every pair of values (g i, g ((i+1) mod n)) whose exclusive or differs from b i. These are the clause "G(e) is nonempty iff the holonomy h is 0" and the clause "holonomy 1 forbids a positive-mass joint measure with parity-supported marginals" of Proposition B6. Not in Lean: the arc-cover clause, the noncontextual-fraction clause and the Cech-cohomology reading.

records.name: Global section, convex hull and noncontextual fraction 1
records.obligation: Not formalised in Lean (ledger row L035-L1, node OPS-LEAN-GAP). The proof is in the note and is not machine-checked.
records.summary: Proposition B3(1). For an empirical model e = (e_C) on a finite scenario, let A be the matrix whose column g, for g in E(M), is the stacked vector of the point masses of g restricted to each context, and let NCF(e) = max of the sum of lambda_g over lambda >= 0 with A lambda <= e. Then these are equivalent: e has a global section (a probability vector d on E(M) with marginal e_C on every context C); e lies in conv(A); NCF(e) = 1. This is the local-hidden-variable condition. Instances recomputed exactly: the mixture (1/2)(delta_g1 + delta_g2), with g1 = (0,0,0,0) and g2 = (1,0,0,1) on (a, a', b, b'), has NCF 1; the noisy PR box (1 - lam) PR + lam U at lam = 1/2 has NCF 1 and a distribution as a global section.

records.name: Strong contextuality is noncontextual fraction 0
records.obligation: Not formalised in Lean (ledger row L035-L1, node OPS-LEAN-GAP).
records.summary: Proposition B3(3). Write G(e) for the set of g in E(M) with e_C(g restricted to C) > 0 for every context C. Then e is strongly contextual (G(e) is empty) if and only if NCF(e) = 0: if lambda_g > 0 is feasible then e_C(g|C) >= lambda_g > 0 for every C, so g is in G(e); conversely g in G(e) makes lambda = (min over C of e_C(g|C)) delta_g feasible with positive weight. Instance recomputed exactly: the PR box on the Bell scenario (contexts ab, ab', a'b, a'b', each uniform on the two outcome pairs with parity 0, 0, 0, 1) has |G| = 0 and NCF 0. The four parity constraints x_a + x_b = 0, x_a + x_b' = 0, x_a' + x_b = 0 and x_a' + x_b' = 1 sum to 0 = 1 modulo 2, so none of the 16 assignments satisfies all.

records.name: Noncontextual fraction of the noisy PR box
records.obligation: Tested points only. The Rust receipt replay clause of the ledger row is in node OPS-RUST-RECEIPTS-AND-LIMITS.
records.summary: On the Bell scenario let the noisy PR box be e_lam = (1 - lam) PR + lam U, where U puts 1/4 on every local outcome pair. The exact noncontextual fraction is 1/2 at lam = 1/4 and 1 at lam = 1/2, which is 2 lam at both points. The l1 defect to conv(A) is positive at lam = 1/4 and 0 at lam = 1/2, and the global support has 16 elements at both points. The closed form 2 lam for every lam below 1/2 is not claimed.

records.name: Descent over the maximal cover never fails to glue
records.obligation: The reading of the proposition as a statement about the Rust classifier is not checked here (not run here). Not formalised in Lean.
records.summary: Proposition B4(1). Let S(U) be the set of assignments s on U whose restriction to every maximal context C inside U lies in the support of e_C; then S(M) = G(e). Over the cover of M by its maximal contexts, every matching family (s_C in S(C), agreeing on overlaps) glues to exactly one element of S(M). So a descent classifier on that cover reports no NoGlobalExtension, its fibers are in bijection with G(e), and strong contextuality appears as zero matching families, not as a failed gluing. Instances recomputed exactly: the PR box has 0 matching families; the noisy PR box at lam = 1/2 has 16, each with exactly one gluing.

records.name: A noncontextual model that fails descent on an arc cover
records.obligation: An existence claim with one witness. The Rust classifier outcome names (Unique, NoGlobalExtension) are read as: exactly one gluing, no gluing. Not run here for the Rust code.
records.summary: Existence witness. On the Bell scenario let e = (1/2)(delta_g1 + delta_g2) with g1 = (a, a', b, b') = (0,0,0,0) and g2 = (1,0,0,1). Then NCF(e) = 1 and G(e) has 2 elements. Over the arc cover {a, a', b}, {a', b, b'}, which omits the context {a, b'}, there are 4 matching families; 2 of them have exactly one gluing in S(M) and 2 have none. So a noncontextual model can have matching families without a global extension on a cover that omits a context.

records.name: NoGlobalExtension alone is not evidence of contextuality
records.obligation: A reading of two earlier nodes. No cover-independent sound reading of NoGlobalExtension is known to the note.
records.summary: Consequence of nodes OPS-MAXIMAL-COVER-DESCENT and OPS-ARC-COVER-NGE-WITNESS. A descent outcome NoGlobalExtension on a matching family is a statement about the chosen cover, not about the model: on the maximal cover it never occurs, and on the arc cover above it occurs for a model with NCF 1. Strong contextuality is G(e) empty, reported as NCF 0 with a Bell functional as the replayable witness. So the note's local-green-global-red event (a matching family over a cover of M whose descent outcome is NoGlobalExtension) is evidence that the cover's local checks do not reach the global object, and not evidence that no global object exists.

records.name: Cech coboundaries, no-signalling and the quotient defect
records.obligation: Phi_1 is the quotient value of the WDP degree-1 window; no source in this graph identifies the Cech-cochain Phi_1 with PG-WDP-DEGREE1-WINDOW with J the l1 norm, so that route is a gap. Not formalised in Lean.
records.summary: Proposition B5. Let N be the nerve of the maximal-context cover and take cochains valued in the presheaf U -> Q^E(U), with (delta0 alpha)_(C,C') the restriction of alpha_C to the overlap minus the restriction of alpha_C', and delta1 the alternating sum of restrictions on triples. Then delta1 delta0 = 0; for an empirical model e read as a 0-cochain, delta0 e = 0 if and only if e is no-signalling; and Phi_1([omega]) = min over alpha of the l1 norm of (omega - delta0 alpha) is unchanged by omega -> omega - delta0 beta. Instances recomputed exactly: the Bell nerve has four edges (a 4-cycle) and no triple, so delta1 delta0 = 0 is vacuous there; on the cover {0,1}, {0,2}, {0,3} (one nerve triple, overlap {0}) delta1 delta0 alpha = 0 for a non-constant alpha while a 1-cochain supported on one pair has delta1 beta = [1, 0]; delta0 e = 0 for the PR box and is nonzero at the pair (0,1) for a model whose a-marginal differs between the contexts ab and ab'; the unit cochain (1, 1) on the first edge of the Bell nerve has Phi_1 = 2, by the value 2 at alpha = 0 and a dual witness of sup norm 1 that annihilates delta0, and Phi_1 is again 2 after adding delta0 of a coboundary.

records.name: The 0-cocycle test does not separate contextual models
records.obligation: Not a statement about every possible cohomological invariant. Not formalised in Lean.
records.summary: Every no-signalling model, the PR box included, has delta0 e = 0 (node OPS-CECH-COBOUNDARY). So the test delta0 e = 0 does not separate contextual from noncontextual no-signalling models. This is a statement about the test, not about the class of e: in the unaugmented complex H^0 = ker delta0, so distinct no-signalling models are distinct classes. What the class lacks is an invariant that separates conv(A) from its complement; that separation is a positivity constraint. The earlier sentence that the class "carries no information about probabilistic contextuality" is narrowed to this.

records.name: Parity cycles: arc-cover descent and noncontextual fraction
records.obligation: Finite cases n = 3, 4, 5 only. The two clauses proved in Lean for every n are in node OPS-PARITY-HOLONOMY-LEAN; the arc-cover and NCF clauses for general n are not claimed.
records.summary: For n = 3, 4, 5 and every one of the 2^n parity-target vectors t on the n-cycle of binary measurements (contexts {m_i, m_(i+1 mod n)}, each distribution uniform on the two pairs with x_i xor x_(i+1) = t_i), let h be the exclusive or of the t_i. Then |G| is 2 if h = 0 and 0 if h = 1; the arc cover {m_0, ..., m_(n-2)}, {m_1, ..., m_(n-1)} has exactly 2 matching families, both with one gluing if h = 0 and both without a gluing if h = 1; and NCF is 1 if h = 0 and 0 if h = 1. That is 8 + 16 + 32 = 56 cases.

records.name: No-signalling and signed global sections
records.obligation: The equivalence is cited, not derived here. The instance covers one no-signalling model and says nothing about the converse direction or about other models.
records.summary: Assumed from Abramsky and Brandenburger (New Journal of Physics 13 (2011) 113036, arXiv:1102.0264), as the note cites it and does not prove it: an empirical model is no-signalling if and only if it has a signed global section, a function d on E(M) with values in Q, sum 1 and the given marginals. Instance recomputed exactly: the PR box, which is no-signalling, has a signed global section found by exact linear algebra, with sum 1, all 16 marginal equations satisfied and at least one negative entry.

records.name: The Z2 holonomy witness can be silent where the LP is not
records.obligation: Cited, not re-run. No family with a silent Z2 witness is exhibited in this repository.
records.summary: Assumed from Abramsky, Mansfield and Barbosa (EPTCS 95 (2012) 1-14, arXiv:1111.3620), as the note cites it: the Z2 holonomy witness of parity constraints can be silent where the linear-programming witness is not, that is, it has false negatives on other families of scenarios. The note does not compute such a family and does not claim the behaviour away.

records.name: Vorob'ev: acyclic covers glue every no-signalling model
records.obligation: Cited theorem with a proof sketch in the note only. Not formalised in Lean.
records.summary: Assumed from Vorob'ev (Theory of Probability and its Applications 7 (1962) 147-163, doi:10.1137/1107014), as the note states it: if the hypergraph (M, C) is GYO-acyclic (it reduces to nothing by removing ears and absorbed vertices, equivalently it has a join tree), then every no-signalling model has a global section given on a join tree T by d(g) = (product over C of e_C(g|C)) / (product over the edges (C, C') of T of e_(C intersect C')(g|C intersect C')), with 0/0 = 0. The note gives an induction sketch, not a full proof. The converse (for every non-acyclic hypergraph some no-signalling family has no global section) is not implemented; the PR box on the 4-cycle is one instance.

records.name: Product-formula gluing on a three-context path
records.obligation: One path cover. The Rust join-tree code and its refusal of the 4-cycle (NotAcyclic) are not run here. The theorem itself is node OPS-VOROBEV-THEOREM.
records.summary: On the path cover {0,1}, {1,2}, {2,3} of four binary measurements, with parity targets 0, 1, 1, the product formula of node OPS-VOROBEV-THEOREM (join-tree edges ({0,1},{1,2}) and ({1,2},{2,3})) gives a probability distribution on the 16 assignments whose three marginals equal the three given tables exactly, and NCF is 1. The GYO reduction empties the three-context path and the two-context path and does not empty the Bell 4-cycle or a triangle. This is one instance of the cited theorem, not a check of it.

records.summary: Lemma A2. Let O' leave one of K, Adm, norm, Term undeclared, and require that an evaluation's receipt for a claim agree across every admissible completion of the undeclared component. Then no evaluation of O' meets that requirement: for each of the four components there are two admissible completions, agreeing elsewhere, whose receipts for one claim differ. Witnesses on the PR box (Bell scenario, parity targets 0, 0, 0, 1): K, the Bell cover gives defect 2 and the acyclic sub-cover {ab, ab'} gives defect 0; Adm, the noncontextual polytope gives 2 and the no-signalling polytope gives 0, because the PR box is no-signalling; norm, the l1 norm gives 2 and twice the l1 norm gives 4; Term, with defect 2 and empty global support the rule of the note gives OpenObstruction and the rule "defect below 3 gives ExactRepair" gives ExactRepair. The lemma does not say that no function from claims to receipts exists; any one completion defines a function. The layer has no row, because Definition A1 fixes it to diagnostic.

records.summary: Axis 3 of WDP-CH14-T01 under three hypotheses. (i) NS-14: an injective renaming sigma of presentation tokens commutes with the transition step and with full-history replay. (ii) CL-13 (passage_charge_const): a quantity conserved by internal transitions is constant on reachable states and equals its genesis value. (iii) The verdict V reads a history only through a declared export Exp, so V = Vbar o Exp, with Exp(sigma(H)) = Exp(H) for every injective renaming sigma; this is the identical-accessible-exports premise of Proposition 3.1 of the Argon synthesis. Then V(sigma(H)) = V(H), because V(sigma(H)) = Vbar(Exp(sigma(H))) = Vbar(Exp(H)) = V(H). Without (iii) the statement is false (node OPS-REFUTED-AXIS3-WIDE). A drop in the internal defect Delta_O stays computable and renaming-invariant; whether a drop is a repair or a reinterpretation is a question about the grounding map of the tokens, which no export-reading verdict decides.
